ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of approximately 85% high-intensity (white) pixels to 15% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Stochastic distribution of small circular dark spots (dots and rings) across both white lobes. Continuous black pigmentation band following the trailing edge margin. Distinct asymmetrical dark blotch located in the lower-central region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a pixel-calculated internal angle of approximately 115 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations between 5 and 15 pixels. Macro-jagged protrusions present at the extreme distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve fitted from the median notch to the tips, characterized by gradual tapering.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous circular and ring-like dark pixel clusters distributed across the central fluke field. Distinct yellowish high-relief pixel clusters (barnacles) localized at the distal tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Yellowish barnacle colonization at the lateral tips of the trailing edge.
